author: Riilo
body:
Howdy, I'm Rilo. Obviously, this thread wasn't expected, even I didn't expect it. I know this sounds really lazy and quite stupid, but I'm losing interest in leading a team. I wasn't made for the role as leader, considering all of the teams I have made never really got anywhere. It isn't 100% confirmed that I am disbanding my current team, but it's definitely leaning to that side. I just wanted to know if any teams were willing to trial me. I don't think many will, but it's worth a shot. If I get no options, then I'll most likely stick to running the team. I'll just leave some additional information below if that interests any of you.

Timezone: AEST (will explain)
Past Teams: All of my teams + NewDawn
Position: Rusher (can make a decent defence on most maps)

Talking about my Timezone. I can slightly avoid this. These are the times I can play on weekends (EST,  AEST and BST)

  • 3PM - 7AM EST (16 hours)
  • 8PM - 12PM BST (16 hours)
  • 5AM - 9PM AEST (16 hours)
The End
